name: app-banking-watch-face-on-a-dark-wrist
title: Banking smartwatch balance screen with orange buttons on a silhouetted wrist
whatItIs: A pale grey background crossed by a dark, backlit forearm with a black smartwatch and green band. The watch shows an account card with balance and card digits on a pearly glass card with two rounded orange Send and Receive buttons.
whatItMeans: Calm and dramatic; the near-black arm makes the small bright screen glow.
techniques: Silhouette the arm against a light backdrop so the screen is the only lit area.
Limit the watch UI to one card and two orange buttons.
Use a pearly gradient card as a payment visual.
Keep the palette to grey, black and orange.

vocabulary.definition: Lighting an object so it appears as a dark shape.
An interface for very quick reading on a small screen.
A card with an iridescent white gradient.
